map.正态分布 CDF 计算器：输入均值、标准差与取值 x，计算标准正态分布累积概率: Normal distribution CDF calculator: enter the mean, standard deviation and value x to compute the standard normal cumulative probability P(X <= x), used for probability and quantile assessment.
map.标准正态累积分布函数 Φ(z) 给出标准正态变量小于等于 z 的概率，即曲线下左: The standard normal cumulative distribution function Phi(z) gives the probability that a standard normal variable is at or below z, that is the area to the left under the curve. Any normal distribution is first standardized as z = (x - mu)/sigma, then Phi(z) gives the cumulative probability. Used for reading normal tables and evaluating quantiles.
map.求 P(Z≤z) 或区间概率。: Find P(Z<=z) or an interval probability.
z=1: Phi(1) = about 0.8413, meaning 84.13% of the data lies below mean + 1 sigma. z=1.96 is about 0.9750.
map.误差函数，正态 CDF 用其表达；多数语言/计算器内置，直接用 Φ(z) 即可。: The error function, used to express the normal CDF; most languages and calculators have it built in, so just use Phi(z).
map.对应 95% 与 99% 双尾置信的临界 z 值，统计表/工具常用。: The critical z values corresponding to 95% and 99% two-tailed confidence, commonly used in statistical tables and tools.
